subject: Request: Executive sanction for Hosted API concession for Brightline Health (35% off)
content:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Michael Chen <michael.chen@brightlinehealth.com>, procurement@brightlinehealth.com
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: Executive sanction for Hosted API concession for Brightline Health (35% off)

Hi Michael / Brightline procurement team —

Following up from Friday's demo and the pricing discussion: Brightline has indicated they need a deeper hosted-API discount to commit to a 12-month consumption commitment (they're targeting ~100M tokens/month in steady-state across US/EU regions). The procurement lead asked whether we can offer a one-time promotional concession of 35% off our published Hosted API rates for the first 12 months to lock the commitment and sign the SOW this quarter.

Why this matters (high level):
- This is a strategic win for us: multi-region deployment (US + EU), reference customer for healthcare vertical, and likely early Dedicated capacity conversion in H2 if performance/stability meets their expectations.
- The customer has committed to co-marketing and a technical case study with the Redwood Applied ML team — reasonable marketing lift and credible logos for future GA deals.
- Competitive pressure: two competitors are pitching substantially lower list prices; this concession is to prevent loss to a lower-cost vendor while we demonstrate superior latency and observability.

Ask: Exec sanction to offer a time-limited 35% discount on Hosted API usage for 12 months with the following guardrails (proposed by AE):
1) Minimum monthly committed spend: $45k/month (equates to the 100M token run-rate they forecast)
2) 12-month fixed term; renewal reverts to standard list rates or a pre-agreed renewal discount (negotiated later)
3) Early termination: remaining committed spend due pro rata if customer exits before term
4) Legal-approved SOW language and data handling clauses for healthcare (we will require their DPA + BAA language review)

Attached: Brightline_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.pdf (MMP), draft SOW, and an initial pricing model. HubSpot deal link and draft DocuSign SOW included at the bottom.

If we can get a provisional exec OK today, I will present a finalized SOW to Legal and Procurement and ask for countersignature by end of week.

Thanks,
Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Brightline_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.pdf (pdf, 240KB)]
[Attachment: SOW_Brightline_draft.docx (docx, 88KB)]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: Executive sanction for Hosted API concession for Brightline Health (35% off)

Tessa —

Thanks for the summary. I need a concise margin and ARR impact in order to evaluate a 35% concession. Please provide:
- Expected gross margin at the proposed rate (including anticipated infra/egress/caching savings from our side)
- Expected incremental ARR and 12-month cash flow profile under the commitment
- Any customer asks that deviate materially from standard T&Cs (data residency, retention, BAA items)

Also loop in Legal if SOW language requires non-standard clauses. If procurement is pushing hard and this is truly strategic, we can consider an exception, but I need the unit economics and the proposed guardrails locked.

Vivek
VP Sales Operations

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Chen <michael.chen@brightlinehealth.com>, procurement@brightlinehealth.com
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 08:37:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: Executive sanction for Hosted API concession for Brightline Health (35% off)

Vivek — thanks, quick numbers below and attached is the detailed model (pricing_model_v2.xlsx). Quoted as conservative estimates.

Unit economics (high level):
- List price target: $0.015 per 1k tokens (example list)
- 35% off effective price: $0.00975 per 1k tokens
- Estimated infra cost to us: $0.0028 per 1k tokens (optimized runtime, KV caching expected to reduce token cost for steady-state prompts)
- Gross margin at promo rate: ~71% (with caching/batching assumptions)

12-month ARR / cash profile:
- Committed minimum monthly spend: $45k -> $540k committed in year 1
- Upside if usage scales to 100M tokens/month: runs to ~ $1.08M revenue at promo rate (year-1 run-rate)
- We project break-even on incremental sales & onboarding costs in quarter 3 given their integration timeline

Non-standard terms / risk notes:
- Customer requests EU data residency for a subset of datasets — Legal will need to sign off on our EU deployment plan and a limited DPA addendum
- They asked for a 30-day SLA credit window for latency breaches in the SOW; recommend this be limited to monitoring-based credits and not financial refunds
- Marketing/case study commitment is verbal today; we will convert into the SOW appendix

Proposed mitigation/guardrails (for exec to accept):
- 35% promotional concession limited to first 12 months and subject to meeting onboarding milestones (MMP schedule in attached PDF)
- Minimum committed spend and early termination fees (outlined in the attached SOW draft)
- Legal must approve data residency language and SLA appendix before countersign

Attachments: pricing_model_v2.xlsx (detailed P&L), SOW_Brightline_draft.docx (redlines visible), Brightline_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.pdf

If this looks acceptable to you, Vivek, can I please get a provisional sanction to present to procurement? Michael — I included a cleaned-up MMP and timing expectations; would like to lock the sign-by date of 2027-06-04 if possible.

Thanks,
Tessa

[Attachment: pricing_model_v2.xlsx (xlsx, 52KB)]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Chen <michael.chen@brightlinehealth.com>, procurement@brightlinehealth.com
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 12:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: Executive sanction for Hosted API concession for Brightline Health (35% off)

Folks —

After reviewing the numbers and the proposed guardrails, Deal Desk provisionally approves a 35% promotional concession for the first 12 months on Hosted API usage with these binding conditions: 
1) Minimum committed spend of $45k/month must be contractually guaranteed
2) Promo rate strictly limited to month 1–12; renewal pricing to be negotiated on actual usage and revised economics
3) Legal must sign off on the EU data residency addendum and the SLA appendix prior to countersignature
4) Marketing/case study commitment must be captured in the SOW appendix (signed)
5) Finance will record the discounted ARR and flag for Q3 revenue recognition review

Please capture this in HubSpot (Deal D-2027-0421) and proceed with Legal/Procurement to finalize. I will escalate if any of the terms are changed materially.

Rishi
Head of Deal Desk
Redwood Inference
